narrative.overview:
HeyNaija is a calm sage wall with clean white notices pinned to it. Every post, notification, form, profile header and side-rail section is its own card. You read it, act on it and move to the next one. The ground stays quiet and the cards stay crisp. One decisive forest green marks everything you can do. The result should feel fresh, tidy and confident: organised and modern, never cold.

The one loud element is the bubbly green wordmark. Everything around it is disciplined: one typeface, one accent, one card. Density comes from rhythm (cards 10px apart, a 12px gutter on phones) rather than from cramming. The system is built to stay fast on low-end Android, so depth is a border and a hairline shadow, not blur or imagery.

The look was redesigned on 14 October 2026 from ruled rows inside a white framed sheet to cards on a tinted ground, using the owner's other project, Koinovera, as the polish reference. The palette, the wordmark and the no-gradients rule were kept from before.
keyCharacteristics: White cards (12px corners, 1px hairline, faint shadow) on a sage-grey ground, with no framing sheet.
A single forest-green accent for actions, the current place and links.
Plus Jakarta Sans throughout, with weight rather than size doing most of the hierarchy work.
Light, dark and system themes; dark keeps the same structure with deeper greens.
Phones get the same cards with 12px gutters and a fixed bottom bar.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Forest green is the only accent. It means "you can act here" or "you are here". No second brand colour, no gradients, and no colours borrowed from AI-tool branding.

rules.name: The No Grey Text on Colour Rule
rules.body: Text on sage wash uses Deep Forest or Pine Ink, never slate.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy steps through 400, 500, 600 and 700 before it reaches for a bigger size. Author names are 600 at 15px, not larger.

rules.name: The No Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing frames the columns. Structure comes from the cards; there are no rules between columns.

rules.name: The Border First Rule
rules.body: Never add depth with a bigger shadow. If a card needs more presence, its border goes to Hairline Strong (as on hover); the shadow stays the same.

dos: Do put every actionable object in a card: white, 12px corners, 1px Hairline border, the Card shadow.
Do keep the ground Sage Ground and let sticky bars use it at 90% opacity.
Do use Forest Green only for actions, the current location and links.
Do keep 10px between feed cards and a 12px gutter on phones.
Do step hierarchy through weight (400–700) before size.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or better: Slate Muted for metadata, never Slate Faint.
donts: Don't reintroduce a framing white sheet or rules between columns.
Don't add gradients, a second accent colour, or colours borrowed from AI-tool branding.
Don't compete with the wordmark: no other display type, illustration-heavy panels or dark slabs in the rail.
Don't nest cards inside cards; inside a card, use Inset Sage fills or hairline dividers.
Don't round anything but avatars fully, or use radii outside 6, 8 and 12px.
Don't add depth with bigger shadows; strengthen the border instead.
